stages.title: Hall Corner
stages.notes: CROP of a great hall's SW corner: two of its walls in frame (west wall down file d with a door, south wall on rank 5 with double doors), the hall's north and east walls lie off-frame. A passage runs down the west edge past a wall stub, a corridor crosses under the hall, and two lesser rooms sit below it — one through a door, one through a broken gap and a corridor mouth at the east edge.

stages.title: The Junction
stages.notes: A north–south corridor meets an east–west one at a T off-centre. A hallway sliced lengthwise runs along the west edge; a chamber NE with a door on each corridor and a rubble gap in its corner; the south room's far walls are off-frame and a wall stub from the bottom edge half-divides it.

stages.title: The Oubliettes
stages.notes: A row of cells along the north edge — three doored, one with the door torn off, the last cut by the frame with its wall fallen to rubble. A two-wide corridor below them runs off the east edge and turns south along the west edge; the guardroom SE (table, an alcove with a chest) opens by a door from the corridor and one from the west passage.

stages.title: The Armoury
stages.notes: The armoury fills the NE with its north and east walls off-frame: racks along the back, a chest, barred double doors west, a door south and a collapsed corner. West of it a small guard closet over a stub of passage; below, a corridor along the bottom edge.

stages.title: The Nave
stages.notes: A chapel cut lengthwise: the nave with pews (one row broken to rubble), a colonnade of pillars to the west aisle, the altar end narrowed by a wall stub, and a sacristy passage east behind a long wall with one door and an open end at the south.

stages.title: Kitchens and Larder
stages.notes: The kitchen SW (long table, barrels) with a doorway north into a servery passage; the larder NW behind its own door; the great hall east of a long wall with a serving hatch and a door, its far side off-frame.

stages.title: Guard Post
stages.notes: A two-wide corridor runs top to bottom with a side passage joining from the west edge. A store NW open at one corner, a barracks SW behind a door with a broken gap in its wall, the guard room east (table) behind a door, a passage NE off the east edge, and a strip of floor along the bottom.

stages.title: The Cistern
stages.notes: A vaulted cistern: pillars scattered where the vault needed them, not on a grid; a small walled chamber in the NE corner with a door and a broken corner; a wall stub from the west edge; fallen masonry and stores near the south.

stages.title: Side Gallery
stages.notes: A four-wide gallery cut lengthwise down the west, a colonnade (one pillar fallen) along its east side, and beyond it two chambers split by a partial wall — the north one with a table, the south with a chest — plus a wall fragment at the top and a stub at the east edge from rooms off-frame.

stages.title: The Switchback
stages.notes: Two long wall stubs from opposite edges force a zigzag: through a door in the first or around its end, then around the second or through its rubble breach. A wall fragment from the top edge and a stub from the bottom make niches; a pillar and bones in the passage.

stages.title: Breached Curtain
stages.notes: A curtain wall down file d, thick where a tower base stands at the south, breached by rubble with crates spilled from the collapse and an open doorway just below. West of it a narrow outer passage; east the ward — a well pillar, a stable stall of barrels behind a stub, a chest.

stages.title: The Strongroom
stages.notes: The strongroom SE with its far walls off-frame: three chests, a door blocked by a crate dragged in front of it, and a rubble breach in its north wall — the second way in. An antechamber west with a pillar, a wide passage across the middle, and a room across the top behind a wall with one door and an open end.

stages.title: The Stair Core
stages.notes: A stair's solid core stands off-centre with the passage wrapping three sides of it. A long wall down file e closes off a west chamber (tables, a closet cut off by a stub from the top edge) with one door; the passage's south end meets a wall with a door into a wide room the crop cut lengthwise.

stages.title: The Barracks
stages.notes: A long barrack room with bunks along the walls (one collapsed), a latrine nook behind a partition with its own door, a corridor two wide down the west edge behind a wall with one door, and a corridor along the south with two doors into the room.

stages.title: The Tower Room
stages.notes: A round tower's interior: its curved wall sweeps across the frame from the curtain wall to the south edge, two thick at the steps so nothing slips through diagonally. A stair newel stands inside; a door in the curtain leads to a corridor along the top, another door opens on the narrow passage that runs round the tower's outside.

stages.title: Wine Cellar
stages.notes: Rows of barrels make the aisles — capturable stores everywhere. A partition with an open gap and a door closes off a stair alcove NW; a pier of three stone blocks props the vault on the east; a chest in a corner.

stages.title: The Cave-in
stages.notes: A corridor two wide crosses the frame; halfway along, the roof came down — stone and rubble fill it. Smash through the rubble, or go round: an open doorway and a door into the room above, and below, the wall stops short of the west edge and has a gap further east. A stub from the east edge in the south room.

stages.title: The Ossuary
stages.notes: A long bone-hall with the west wall in frame (broken open at its south end) and side-alcoves down the east behind wall stubs of uneven length. An altar at the north end, ossuary chests in the alcoves, bones where they fell, one pillar.

stages.title: The Smithy
stages.notes: The forge: a hearth block in the SW corner, an anvil, benches, water barrels along the west wall, and a wide double door north into the yard (a well pillar). A store behind the east wall, reached by an open doorway from the forge and open to the yard at its far end.

stages.title: The Scriptorium
stages.notes: Stacks of shelves in uneven rows with aisles between, a partition wall with a door and a gap where it ends, a reading room beyond (tables, a chest), a wall along the south with one door and a corridor under it.

stages.title: The Gate Passage
stages.notes: The inner face of a gatehouse: a wall two thick across the frame, the gate passage through it closed by a portcullis pair, a one-wide postern door further along, a tower base bulging into the bailey, a guard stub SW. Outside lies to the north with an abandoned cart.

stages.title: The Mess
stages.notes: A mess hall defined by its furniture: three long tables staggered down the room, one broken, two pillars, and the kitchen wall east with a serving hatch, a door, and its north end open where the partition stops short.

stages.title: Dead Ends
stages.notes: A rock-cut warren: a corridor four wide comes in from the top and turns along the bottom. Off it, a side passage that dead-ends at a collapsed chest niche, another that runs off the east edge, an alcove in the west wall, and a rubble pile at the turn.

stages.title: The Grotto
stages.notes: A natural cave: no straight walls, rock in clumps — a mass in the NW corner, a boulder mid-floor, a tongue of rock from the east edge, stalagmites in the south — with fallen rubble and a lost chest.

stages.title: The Throne Room
stages.notes: An audience hall: the dais wall across the north end with the steps as a two-wide gap off-centre and a side door at its east end, the throne on the dais, pillars flanking an aisle at uneven spacing (one fallen to rubble), the east wall in frame with one door and a chest beneath it.

stages.title: The Fissure
stages.notes: A fault runs across the frame from NW to SE, two thick so nothing slips through on the diagonal. It is crossed once through choked rubble and once through a clean gap near the east edge; a stalagmite and a rock stub from the bottom edge stand on the wide side, a chest lies in the far point.

stages.title: Twin Passages
stages.notes: Two passages running top to bottom, separated by a wall (its north end gone) with a door, an open gap and a second door blocked by a crate dragged in front of it. A second wall east with a rubble gap, a door and an open end closes three bays of uneven height along the east edge; a chest in the middle one.

stages.title: The Warehouse
stages.notes: A goods store: crate stacks as two-by-two blocks and pairs scattered where they were left, two pillars, a corner stub, and an office partition west with one door and a clerk's table behind it.

stages.title: The Stables
stages.notes: Stalls along the north wall, divided by stubs at uneven spacing (one stall a single square wide), a hay store in the last, water barrels along the west, a cart standing in the aisle, a tack wall east, and the yard wall south with one door.

stages.title: The Ruin
stages.notes: Decay: the outlines of two rooms whose walls have fallen into runs of stone, rubble and gaps — a wall is standing here, rubble there, nothing at all further along. A collapsed partition, a broken pillar, a chest still in its corner.

stages.title: The Solar
stages.notes: An enfilade of three rooms with their doors in a line: a closet west with a privy screen, the bedchamber (bed, hearth block, chest, a second door) and a room east the crop cut short, its wall broken at the top. The west wall has a gap low down; the east door stands open.

stages.title: Crossroads Vault
stages.notes: A true four-way crossing, off-centre, with four unequal quadrants: rock NW with a shrine niche cut into it, a vaulted room NE with a door on one arm and a gap on the other, open cave SW, a small chamber SE behind a door.

stages.title: The Arcade
stages.notes: A hall split lengthwise by an arcade — arches at unequal spacing in a wall down file d — with a solid stair block in the nave, a screen wall across the nave's south end with one door, a pillar, and barrels in the aisle.

stages.title: Undercroft to Cave
stages.notes: Where the built dungeon ends: masonry on the west — a straight wall with a door, piers, a south wall with a gap — giving way to natural rock in clumps on the east, with rubble where the two meet and a chest lost in the cave.

stages.title: The Garth
stages.notes: A cloister garth: the walk along the north and east behind pillar rows at uneven spacing, the open garden with a well, a building corner intruding SW, a buttress from the bottom edge, a bench and a chest in the walk.

stages.title: The Tannery
stages.notes: An L-shaped workshop: vats in a block, a frame table, a partition stub from the top edge, a pillar; the L's inner corner is a wall two thick with a broken door, and an alley two wide runs down the east edge behind it with a door into the L's foot.
